blocks.title: Atomic emission spectrum
blocks.text: Jab kisi element ko gas ki halat mein bohat zyada temperature tak garam kiya jaye ya us mein se electric discharge (bijli ki chingari) guzari jaye, to woh kuch khaas wavelengths ki radiation (roshni) chhorta hai. Is radiation ke spectrum mein rangeen lines hoti hain; isay atomic emission spectrum kehte hain.
Hydrogen ka atomic emission spectrum Figure 2.2 (a) mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Atomic absorption spectrum
blocks.text: Jab safed roshni (white light) ki beam kisi element ki thandi gas mein se guzari jaye to kuch khaas wavelengths atoms jazb (absorb) kar lete hain. Jazb hone wali wavelengths spectrum par kaali (dark) lines ki shakal mein nazar aati hain. Is spectrum ko atomic absorption spectrum kehte hain.
Hydrogen ka atomic absorption spectrum Figure 2.2 (b) mein hai. Absorption spectrum ki kaali lines bilkul unhi wavelengths par hain jin par emission spectrum ki rangeen lines hain.

blocks.alt: (a) Hydrogen ka emission spectrum: gehre grey patte par chaar rangeen lakeerein, banafshi, neeli-banafshi, neeli-hari aur surkh. (b) Hydrogen ka absorption spectrum: banafshi se surkh tak musalsal rang, jin par unhi jagahon par chaar siyah lakeerein. Neeche 400 nm se 700 nm ka paimana.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.2: (a) hydrogen ka atomic emission spectrum (b) hydrogen ka atomic absorption spectrum (kitab ki Figure 2.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar (a) mein garam hydrogen sirf chaar rangon ki lines deti hai. Neeche (b) mein safed roshni thandi hydrogen se guzarti hai to bilkul unhi chaar jagahon par roshni jazb ho jati hai aur kaali lines reh jati hain. Scale par yeh lines 410, 434, 486 aur 656 nm par hain.

Har element ke electrons ki tarteeb apni alag (unique) hai, is liye us ke fixed energy levels bhi alag hain. Jab electrons ek energy level se doosre mein jump karte hain to jo radiation nikalti ya jazb hoti hai, us ki wavelengths aur frequencies bhi har element ke liye alag hoti hain. Is liye har element ka apna khaas (characteristic) spectrum hai aur usi se element pehchana jata hai. Isi liye kehte hain ke atomic spectra elements ke finger prints (ungliyon ke nishan) hain. Figure 2.3 kuch elements ke emission spectra dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Hydrogen, helium, neon, sodium aur mercury ke emission spectra, har ek grey patta jis par rangeen lakeerein hain, surkh baen taraf. Hydrogen ki lakeeron par 656 nm, 486 nm, 434 nm aur 410 nm likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.3: Spectrometer se banaye gaye mukhtalif anasir ke spectral series (kitab ki Figure 2.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Jaise har insaan ke finger prints alag hote hain, waise hi har element ki spectrum lines ki jagah alag hai. Kisi sitare (star) ki roshni ki lines dekh kar bhi pata chal jata hai ke us mein kaun se elements hain.

blocks.prompt: Absorption spectrum ki kaali lines bilkul emission spectrum ki rangeen lines wali wavelengths par kyun hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Dono atom ke unhi fixed energy levels se banti hain. Emission mein electron oonche level se neeche girta hai aur theek us energy farq ki roshni deta hai; absorption mein electron wahi roshni le kar neeche se oopar jump karta hai. Wahi levels, wahi farq, is liye wahi wavelengths.

items: Emission spectrum: garam ya discharge wali gas se rangeen lines. Absorption spectrum: thandi gas safed roshni se jo jazb kare, wahan kaali lines; dono ki wavelengths ek hi (hydrogen: 656, 486, 434, 410 nm).
Har element ke fixed energy levels us ka alag spectrum dete hain: yeh us ka finger print hai.
